member.summary: Tests for UNC path normalization in .
member.remarks: UNC paths have the form \\server\share\path on Windows. After normalization they must produce //server/share/path. The leading double-slash must be preserved; collapsing it to a single slash produces an invalid path that matchers cannot evaluate correctly.

member.name: M:Jeninnet.FileQuery.Tests.Core.PathUtilitiesUncTests.Normalize_UncRoot_WithTrailingSlash_SlashPreserved
member.summary: A UNC root path with a trailing slash (\\server\share\) must preserve that trailing slash after normalization, because it identifies the root of the share — not a redundant separator.
member.remarks: Regression guard: the previous IsUncRoot implementation counted total slashes (== 3). "//server/share/" has 4 slashes, so IsUncRoot returned and TrimTrailingSlash removed the final slash. This test failed before the structural-parsing fix.
